description: Restore a session to a previous compaction snapshot. Wraps `sessions.compaction.restore`. Destructive — overwrites current session state with the snapshot. The current state is lost unless you branched first.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

sessionId.description: Optional session id; required when the snapshot id is ambiguous.

name: openclaw_sessions_compaction_restore
